test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following said that “English education has enslaved us”?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** was a** political and spiritual leader** in India.
 
• He played a key role in the **Indian independence movement.**
 
• He believed that **English education had enslaved Indians** and that it was necessary to promote indigenous education to achieve true freedom.
 
• He advocated for the use of **vernacular languages in education **and the promotion of traditional Indian knowledge systems.
 
• Gandhi believed that **education should be accessible to all**, regardless of their social or economic status.
 
• He emphasized the **importance of education in building a just and equitable society.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
__**Raja Ram Mohan Roy**__:

 __
 
• **Founder of Brahmo Samaj**: Pioneered the **Brahmo Sabha**, a social-religious reform movement in India.
 
• **Abolitionist**: Advocated against **sati** (widow burning) and child marriage.
 
• **Father of Indian Renaissance**: His influence extended to politics, education, and religion.
 
• **BBC Ranking**: Ranked as the **10th Greatest Bengali of All Time**.
 
• **Early Life**: Born in Bengal, he was a scholar of Sanskrit, Persian, and English.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Muhammad Iqbal**__:

 __
 
• **Philosopher and Poet**: His poetry is among the greatest of the 20th century.
 
• **Pakistan Movement**: Vision for a separate Muslim state animated the impulse for Pakistan..
 
• **Education**: Trained as a barrister in England and Germany.
 
• **Literary Works**: Notable compositions include “Asrar-e-Khudi” and “Bang-e-Dara.”
 
 
 
• 
 
**Muhammad Ali Jinnah**__:

 
 
• **Founder of Pakistan**: Led the All-India Muslim League and envisioned Pakistan.
 
• **Barrister and Politician**: Trained in law, he played a key role in the Pakistan Movement.
 
• **Quaid-e-Azam**: Revered as the **Great Leader** of Pakistan.
 
• **Unity, Faith, Discipline**: His motto for the new nation.
 
• **Mazar-e-Quaid**: Resting place in Karachi, Pakistan.
